description: Anatomy quality canon for full-body and partial-body figures.

quality_dimensions.name: Limb Count
quality_dimensions.description: Correct number of limbs for the species or character type.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Extra or missing limbs, fingers, or toes.

quality_dimensions.name: Joint Plausibility
quality_dimensions.description: Joints must bend in anatomically possible directions.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Elbows and knees bend in one primary direction. Shoulder and hip rotation natural.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Joints bend backwards or rotate impossibly.

quality_dimensions.name: Proportion
quality_dimensions.description: Body proportions must be within human variance unless stylized.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Head-to-body ratio appropriate. Limbs proportional to torso.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Giraffe neck, t-rex arms, or other gross proportion errors.
